Keltner_Squeeze_Breakout.name: Keltner Squeeze Breakout
Keltner_Squeeze_Breakout.description: Detects Bollinger Band squeeze inside Keltner Channel, enters on expansion with volume surge. 84.7% avg WR across 12 asset combos.
Keltner_Squeeze_Breakout.pros: High win rate (84.7%), very low drawdown (0.3%), works across crypto + equity + futures
Keltner_Squeeze_Breakout.cons: Low trade frequency (avg 2.2 trades/symbol), needs squeeze setup

Triple_EMA_Pullback.name: Triple EMA Pullback
Triple_EMA_Pullback.description: EMA 9/21/50 alignment + price pullback to EMA21 zone + RSI confirmation. Designed for prop firm challenges with tight risk. 65.4% avg WR.
Triple_EMA_Pullback.pros: Consistent across all asset classes, good trade frequency (19/symbol), excellent Sharpe
Triple_EMA_Pullback.cons: Needs trending market, fails in choppy conditions

VWAP_Mean_Reversion.name: VWAP Mean Reversion
VWAP_Mean_Reversion.description: Fades 2+ std dev extensions from rolling VWAP with RSI extreme + volume exhaustion. 83.1% avg WR. Best performer on futures.
VWAP_Mean_Reversion.pros: Highest WR (83.1%), works exceptionally on futures/equities, natural mean reversion target
VWAP_Mean_Reversion.cons: Needs volatile market for setups, fewer signals in quiet markets

Inverse_FVG_Contrarian.name: Inverse Fair Value Gap
Inverse_FVG_Contrarian.description: Fades Fair Value Gaps instead of trading with them. Based on 0% WR of standard FVG in our forward tests (inverted = 100% WR). 65.0% avg WR in backtest.
Inverse_FVG_Contrarian.pros: High volume (289 trades), works on all assets, contrarian edge validated by our live data
Inverse_FVG_Contrarian.cons: Lower WR than other new strategies, needs volume confirmation

StochRSI_Divergence.name: StochRSI Divergence
StochRSI_Divergence.description: Stochastic RSI crossover from extreme zones + hidden bullish divergence + EMA trend filter. 61.2% avg WR.
StochRSI_Divergence.pros: Highest trade count (338), good risk-adjusted returns, catches momentum shifts
StochRSI_Divergence.cons: Slightly lower WR than top strategies, occasional false divergence signals

PropFirm_Conservative.name: Prop Firm Conservative
PropFirm_Conservative.description: Purpose-built for funded trader challenges: EMA trend + RSI confirmation + vol filter + tight risk. Max 2% risk/trade, <5% DD. 62.6% avg WR.
PropFirm_Conservative.pros: Specifically designed for prop firms, 0.8% avg DD, strong on futures (CL, GC)
PropFirm_Conservative.cons: Conservative = fewer signals, may underperform in strong trends
